items.text: Chairman and CEO Ted Pick said Morgan Stanley is focused on both public and private ecosystems, and that the objective is to cover growth companies and their employees from founding to their public maturity while broadening investor access to private companies.
items.quote: We are focused on both the public and the private ecosystems, augmented by our recent acquisition of EquityZen. The objective is to cover growth companies and their employees from founding to their public maturity while broadening access for investors to the growing stack of private companies.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's strategic update deck lays out an integrated-firm capability map spanning Corporates, Founders/Employees, Early Stage, and Public Company, including 'Founders Wealth Strategies,' 'Preserve Wealth,' and 'Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning.'
items.quote: Corporates / Founders / Employees / Early Stage / Public Company ... Financial Wellness and Employee Benefits ... Founders Wealth Strategies ... Preserve Wealth ... Full-Service Wealth Advice and Asset Allocation ... Family Office Solutions, Trust & Estate Planning

items.text: Ted Pick said the Morgan Stanley at Work business, with its exclusive partnership with Carta, positions the firm as an early trusted advisor to over 50,000 private companies, and that employees across workplace companies benefit from management of equity compensation plans, liquidity opportunities, and full-service advice.
items.quote: Our Morgan Stanley at Work business, with its exclusive partnership with Carta, positions us as an early trusted advisor to over 50,000 private companies.

items.text: CFO Sharon Yeshaya said Morgan Stanley has an exclusive partnership with Carta under which Carta will refer private stock-plan companies to Morgan Stanley as they move toward going public, creating a seamless experience for those clients.
items.quote: we have an exclusive partnership with Carta, which means that they will refer those private different stock plans or different corporate companies to Morgan Stanley as they move into going public.

items.text: CFO Sharon Yeshaya described how Morgan Stanley understands the full cap table and early investors, so that IPO-related flows (e.g., an endowment receiving stock) can move from a transfer agent into a Morgan Stanley advice-based relationship across different portions of the cap table.
items.quote: we have a full cap table. We understand early investors. And you can think, for example, of an endowment that might receive a stock associated with an IPO. He or she might take that and put it through from a transfer agent into a Morgan Stanley advice-based relationship.
